caption: Broccoli tots for baby-led weaning & toddlers 🤍 Soft on the inside, crispy outside, and perfect for little hands. Ingredients: • 125g broccoli, steamed • ½ cup breadcrumbs • 1 cup shredded cheese • 1 egg • ½ tsp onion powder Directions: Mash the steamed broccoli, mix with remaining ingredients, form into tots, and bake. Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 18–20 minutes, flipping once, until golden. 👉 For BLW: make larger tots, ensure soft texture, and allow to cool before serving.
